overview.title: What is The Bitcoin District?
overview.text: The Bitcoin District is a Bitcoin-first freedom community in Próspera ZEDE on Roatán, Honduras, where residents pay taxes and transact in Bitcoin.

overview.title: Who joins The Bitcoin District?
overview.text: The Bitcoin District draws Bitcoiners, digital nomads, entrepreneurs, and freedom-minded individuals who want to build their lives and businesses on a sound money standard. Members include Bitcoin educators, miners, startup founders, and investors attracted by Próspera's low-tax jurisdiction, common-law legal framework, and Caribbean lifestyle.

overview.title: A Neighborhood and an Ecosystem
overview.text: The Bitcoin District is both a physical neighborhood within Próspera ZEDE and a growing ecosystem of businesses, events, and services. Residents can incorporate a company in a day, pay 1% business income tax and 5% personal income tax, and settle disputes through the Próspera Arbitration Center - all while living on Roatán island's Caribbean coast.

history.text:
The Bitcoin District grew from a cluster of Bitcoin-aligned pioneers who arrived in Próspera ZEDE on Roatán island starting in 2022. The key early move was the opening of the [Bitcoin Center Roatán](https://thebitcoindistrict.com) inside Próspera, founded by Dušan Matuška - a Slovakian Bitcoin miner and educator - after Próspera's operator offered him space to build Honduras's first Bitcoin education hub.

That same year, Próspera became one of the first jurisdictions to formally recognize Bitcoin as a legal unit of account, allowing businesses to price goods, do accounting, and pay taxes in BTC. This drew Bitcoin-focused entrepreneurs, miners, and freedom-minded nomads to the zone.

The Bitcoin District crystallized as a distinct community and brand at Bitcoin block 896896, roughly mid-2025. The founding team launched the [BitChill retreat series](https://thebitcoindistrict.com/bitchill/) to bring visitors into the ecosystem in a structured format - combining workshops, outdoor activities, and community meals on the Caribbean coast.

By early 2026, the community announced [Orangeville](https://thebitcoindistrict.com/orangeville), a 13-unit modular housing project priced entirely in Bitcoin, moving from event-based gathering toward a permanent neighborhood.

location:
The Bitcoin District is located within Próspera ZEDE on the north side of Roatán island, Honduras - a Caribbean island roughly 60 km off the Honduran coast. Próspera sits across two green valleys and hosts a [Bitcoin Center](https://thebitcoindistrict.com), tennis court, golf course, several hotels, restaurants and cafes, a scuba shop, and Duna - the main hub for entrepreneurs and nomads hosting weekly workshops and events.

Roatán is served by Juan Manuel Gálvez International Airport with direct flights from Houston, Miami, Atlanta, and Dallas, and onward connections via El Salvador. Próspera operates under the Roatán Common Law Code, a framework based on Anglo-American common law, and residents interact with the zone through the ePróspera portal for company registration, permits, and Bitcoin tax payments.
duration:
The Bitcoin District accommodates stays of any length. [BitChill retreats](https://thebitcoindistrict.com/bitchill/) run 7-10 days per season and are the most accessible entry point for newcomers - no prior Próspera connection required. Monthly events like Satoshi Saturdays (first Saturday of each month) and Próspera Weekends offer weekend-length engagement for visitors and prospective residents.

Full physical residents and e-residents can remain in Próspera indefinitely. The community includes a mix of permanent residents and part-time members who cycle through seasonally. Próspera's e-Residency program allows remote engagement without requiring physical presence on the island.
pricing:
BitChill retreat tickets start at 200,000 sats per season (7+ days of activities and amenities included; accommodation and meals are separate). Charter flight from El Salvador to Roatán ran 650,000 sats in past seasons. Nightly accommodation options inside Próspera range from 40,000 sats (Beta Hostel) to 100,000 sats (Duna studio) to 400,000 sats (Pristine Bay villa).

[Orangeville](https://thebitcoindistrict.com/orangeville) residential units are priced in Bitcoin: 50 m² units start at 2 BTC, 75 m² units at 3 BTC, and 100 m² units at 4 BTC. A refundable 0.1 BTC deposit secures early placement; construction begins when 60% presale is reached (target: Q3 2026). Units can be owned outright or fractionally via an LLC for privacy, and can be rented out when not in use. Bitcoin-backed loans are available from 2% APR.

Próspera residency tax rates: 1% business income tax, 5% personal income tax, 2.5% VAT on retail sales, no capital gains tax, no payroll or wealth taxes. Taxes can be paid in Bitcoin.

howToEnter.text: To explore joining The Bitcoin District, start by booking a free discovery call at [cal.com/bitcoindistrict](https://cal.com/bitcoindistrict). The team offers guided onboarding through Próspera Weekends - monthly visits with workshops, dining, and community activities that give prospective residents a feel for life in the zone. Attending a [BitChill retreat](https://thebitcoindistrict.com/bitchill/) is the most common first step for newcomers. For real estate inquiries contact orangeville@thebitcoindistrict.com; for events and retreats contact events@thebitcoindistrict.com.

faqs.question: What is The Bitcoin District?
faqs.answer: The Bitcoin District is a Bitcoin-first startup society and neighborhood inside Próspera ZEDE on Roatán island, Honduras. It offers residency, business incorporation, community events, and real estate - all denominated in Bitcoin. Learn more at [thebitcoindistrict.com](https://thebitcoindistrict.com).

faqs.question: Where exactly is The Bitcoin District located?
faqs.answer: The Bitcoin District is inside Próspera ZEDE on Roatán island, Honduras - a Caribbean island about 60 km off the Honduran coast, known for reef diving and warm waters. The island is served by Juan Manuel Gálvez International Airport with direct flights from Houston, Miami, Atlanta, and Dallas.

faqs.question: Is Bitcoin actually recognized as legal tender in Próspera?
faqs.answer: Yes. Since April 2022, Próspera has recognized Bitcoin as a legal unit of account. Businesses can price goods, do accounting, and pay taxes in Bitcoin. It was among the first jurisdictions globally to formally adopt this status.

faqs.question: What are the tax rates in Próspera?
faqs.answer: Próspera charges 1% business income tax, 5% personal income tax, and 2.5% VAT on retail sales. There is no capital gains tax, no payroll tax, no import tax, and no wealth tax. Taxes are territorial (only locally earned income is taxed) and can be paid in Bitcoin.

faqs.question: What is a BitChill retreat?
faqs.answer: BitChill is The Bitcoin District's flagship retreat series - week-long immersive gatherings in Próspera combining Bitcoin workshops, diving, sailing, yoga, open mics, and community building. Season 1 ran November 18-25, 2025 with 31 participants; Season 2 ran January 18-28, 2026. [See the retreat page](https://thebitcoindistrict.com/bitchill/) for upcoming dates.

faqs.question: How do I join The Bitcoin District?
faqs.answer: Start by booking a discovery call at [cal.com/bitcoindistrict](https://cal.com/bitcoindistrict). The easiest first step is attending a [BitChill retreat](https://thebitcoindistrict.com/bitchill/) or a monthly Próspera Weekend. For real estate inquiries contact orangeville@thebitcoindistrict.com.

faqs.question: What is Orangeville?
faqs.answer: Orangeville is The Bitcoin District's residential housing project - 13 modular units inside Próspera where the jungle meets the sea. Units range from 50 m² (starting at 2 BTC) to 100 m² (starting at 4 BTC). Ownership can be structured via an LLC for privacy, and units can be rented out when not in use. Construction begins when 60% presale is reached (target: Q3 2026); a refundable 0.1 BTC deposit secures early placement. [Learn more](https://thebitcoindistrict.com/orangeville).

faqs.question: What is Próspera ZEDE and how does it work?
faqs.answer: Próspera is a Zone for Employment and Economic Development (ZEDE) - a semi-autonomous jurisdiction within Honduras operating under the Roatán Common Law Code, based on Anglo-American common law. Residents and businesses can choose from 30+ peer-country regulatory frameworks or design their own. Companies can be incorporated in as little as one day via the ePróspera portal.

faqs.question: What is the legal status of Próspera?
faqs.answer: Honduras repealed the ZEDE law in April 2022 and the Supreme Court declared ZEDEs unconstitutional. Próspera's operator argues a 50-year contractual protection applies and has filed a $10.775 billion investor-state claim via ICSID. As of 2026, Próspera continues to operate. Prospective residents and investors should factor this ongoing legal uncertainty into their decisions.

faqs.question: What community events does The Bitcoin District host?
faqs.answer: Regular events include Satoshi Saturdays (beachside meetups every first Saturday), Coworking Tuesdays (weekly workshops at the Bitcoin Center), and Próspera Weekends (monthly onboarding with workshops and dining). The [BitChill retreat series](https://thebitcoindistrict.com/bitchill/) runs seasonally with 7-10 day programs. Custom retreats for teams, investors, or hackathons can be arranged via events@thebitcoindistrict.com.

faqs.question: Who are the core team members of The Bitcoin District?
faqs.answer: The Bitcoin District lists seven core guides: Dusan, Joel, Lukas, Mike, Petar, Tomek, and Tone. Dušan Matuška is the most publicly documented - he founded the Bitcoin Center Roatán in 2022 and co-founded AmityAge Academy, a Bitcoin education organization inside Próspera with a goal of teaching Bitcoin to 100 million people by 2030.

faqs.question: How do I join the Telegram community?
faqs.answer: The Bitcoin District's Telegram is open to join at [telegram.thebitcoindistrict.com](https://telegram.thebitcoindistrict.com/). The community covers events, news, job opportunities, and district planning. The team describes the project as being in an early alpha phase.
